Marissa / team — quick product-side notes after skimming Patrick's spreadsheet: 

1) Fields: user_id, request_id, model, token_count, action_type — all currently available at ingress and in request metadata. Two caveats: prompt_hash is only present if the customer opts into prompt-hashing at ingest (we drop raw prompt payloads by default for PII reasons). If HealthEdge requires prompt_hash, we should include that as a configurable flag in the SOW.

2) KV-cache / prefix-cache events: we do emit cache hit/miss counters at the host level but not the per-request KV delta by default. If they need per-request KV event lines (forensics use), that's an engineering change (adds ~10–15% additional token-level logging overhead). We should offer it as an optional "forensics trace" add-on in the SOW.

3) Retention tiers: product is fine exposing tiering options; need input from infra for cost and operational constraints — esp. for 7y cold storage.

4) BYOK/Keystore: we currently support customer-managed keys through KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS) and an HSM-backed option for Dedicated customers. However, ephemeral per-inference keys are not a first-class flow; current pattern is short-lived signing keys issued by our control plane upon successful KMS handshake. If HealthEdge needs per-inference client-supplied keys (where they keep key material and we never see it), that's a design gap. Recommend offering: (a) KMS-backed envelope encryption + rotation (supported), (b) HSM-backed trust boundary for Dedicated (supported), (c) "BYO-HSM (air-gapped)" as a premium project (workload-dependent).

Let me know if we want to surface option (b) vs (c) in the SOW.

-Jonas

Subject: Re: Audit field map + BYOK for prod logs — need scope for SOW

Folks — infra notes and rough implementation constraints: 

- Audit fields: we can emit all the requested columns at ingest time. Implementation plan: add a per-tenant auditing service that snapshots request metadata (user_id, request_id, model, variant, token_count, action_type) to an append-only audit topic. This will be CDC'd into cold storage per retention policy.

- Prompt_hash: we can compute a stable prompt_hash without storing prompt contents (hash on ingest, discard prompt) — requires opt-in. Privacy review ok.

- KV-cache events: exposing per-request KV diffs requires instrumenting the serving layer to emit delta events; runway estimate 3 sprints (6 weeks) if we scope it as "trace mode" gated by tenant flag. It will increase CPU and storage ~10–20% for enabled tenants. I attached a simple diagram of the handshake and flow.

Attachment: keystore_flow.png (diagram stub)

- Keystore handshake: supported modes today: AWS KMS envelope encryption, GCP KMS, and HSM-managed keys for Dedicated. We do not accept customer-supplied private key material where Redwood performs inference while never seeing keys (true BYO-HSM) unless we run an air-gapped Dedicated stack in their environment. Rotation/cadence: for KMS we support automated rotation hooks; for HSM we can do scheduled rotations but need maintenance windows.

- SLO/operational notes: 7y retention will require cold storage export and retrieval pathway — restore times will be hours for cold archives. Cost estimate: additional 0.8–1.1x storage cost for 7y vs 1y (depends on compression). I'll put numbers in the decision matrix.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Inference Platform

Subject: Re: Audit field map + BYOK for prod logs — need scope for SOW

Patrick / HealthEdge contracts — thanks for the detailed ask. Internal answers and proposed options below; attaching a short SOW draft that maps options to pricing/effort.

Decisions / options we can include in SOW:

1) Audit fields: Redwood will emit the requested columns (user_id, request_id, model, variant, token_count, action_type). Prompt_hash is available as an opt-in toggle (we will compute hash at ingest and not store raw prompt text).

2) KV-cache / forensics traces: offered as an optional "trace mode" (adds additional cost). If enabled, per-request KV delta events will be emitted. Implementation ETA: ~6 weeks (project scoping required).

3) Retention tiers: we will support 30d, 1y, and 7y. 7y will be archived to cold storage with restore windows of up to several hours; pricing shown in SOW-draft.pdf.

4) BYOK / Keystore: supported flows we recommend surfacing in the SOW:
   - KMS envelope encryption (AWS/GCP): supported and can be used for key rotation, recommended for hosted deployments.
   - HSM-backed keys for Dedicated customers: supported; requires configuration and maintenance windows.
   - True BYO-HSM where HealthEdge retains all key material and we never receive key material: supported only via air-gapped Dedicated deployment (this is a custom project and will be scoped separately).

Next steps / action items:
- Patrick: confirm if prompt_hash opt-in is acceptable and whether HealthEdge wants trace-mode KV deltas in scope (reply by EOD Fri, Apr 13).
- Contracts (HealthEdge): flag any language changes needed in SOW-draft.pdf and share redlines.
- Jonas / Rishi / Kimberly: I'll sync with infra/product to finalize cost numbers and a one-page decision matrix; please add any missing constraints to the JIRA ticket (JIRA-SEC-889).

Proposed sync: 30-min call Tue Apr 12, 10:00am PT to align on SOW items and agree on delivery ETA.

Thanks — I'll update the draft SOW once we hear back.

Marissa Cole
Director, Product — Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
